items.review_rationale: Reviewed the full fibration axiom, preserving its quantification over base arrows into the image of an object, and using precisely the existing cartesian arrow notion without introducing a cleavage.

references.phrase: objects and arrows of E and C
for each object and base morphism, a lift exists
references.disposition: The lifting requirement defines the fibration itself; no splitting or groupoid-fibre condition follows.

items.review_rationale: Read all quantified object and arrow roles, including the base-arrow commuting condition, and distinguished the cartesian factorization from ordinary categorical products or limits.

references.disposition: The commuting-base constraint and unique factorization are part of the cartesian-arrow definition.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed both formulations of universal exactness: a short exact sequence and its first-arrow injectivity under tensoring by every module, with no weakening of universal quantifiers.

references.phrase: injectivity of the first arrow after tensoring

references.disposition: The given equivalence retains exactness after all tensor products, not just ordinary exactness.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the exact tensor-induced module homomorphism and its injectivity requirement for every R-module Q, including non-flat Q.

references.context: Module theory: injective module map, here induced by tensoring

references.disposition: The stated quantifier is over all Q; not only flat or finitely presented modules.
